falsifiable_hypothesis: The interpolated weighted median slightly lowered mean development error but retained the raw estimator's one-fold instability. Standard jackknife bias correction may stabilize that smoother estimator with less distortion than correcting the discontinuous first-crossing median.
geometry_rule: For each fitting slice, compute theta_full=log bandwidth from the midpoint-CDF interpolated cross-patient weighted median. Delete each whole patient once and recompute theta_-g with the same interpolated estimator. With G fitting patients use the standard jackknife bias correction theta_bc=G*theta_full-(G-1)*mean_g(theta_-g), then b_bc=exp(theta_bc). No clipping, outcome inputs, correction-strength menu or held-patient information.
spectral_rule: Reuse the bandwidth-0.7 spectral option already selected within each outer-training partition by the authenticated public replay.

task_contract.ab_rule: average separately costed A/B losses; never average A/B predictions
